security_audit.summary: The static findings are false positives caused by search-domain terminology, Markdown backticks, keyword variable names, and asyncpg conn.fetch. A semantic review found one medium-risk issue: the PostgreSQL template builds part of a SQL WHERE clause from unvalidated metadata keys.

remediation.issue: Dynamic SQL filter keys in the PostgreSQL example
remediation.suggestion: Validate metadata keys against an allowlist before building the WHERE clause, or use a parameterized JSONB containment query that avoids string interpolation.

remediation.issue: Template code may be copied into production without security review
remediation.suggestion: Add a short note that all examples require project-specific validation, tests, and input handling before deployment.

semantic_findings.title: Dynamic SQL Filter Construction
semantic_findings.description: The PostgreSQL example inserts metadata key names into a SQL string before conn.fetch. If filter_metadata keys come from a user, an attacker can alter the WHERE clause.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Values are parameterized, but metadata key names are interpolated directly into SQL. The risk depends on whether filter keys are user controlled, so confidence is high but not absolute.

content.user_title: Build Hybrid Search for RAG Systems
content.value_statement: Pure vector search can miss exact names, codes, and domain terms. This skill combines semantic retrieval with keyword search, fusion, and reranking patterns.
actual_capabilities: Explains when to combine vector similarity with keyword retrieval.
Provides reciprocal rank fusion and linear score fusion patterns.
Shows PostgreSQL pgvector and full-text search implementation ideas.
Shows Elasticsearch dense vector and BM25 hybrid query patterns.
Outlines a RAG pipeline with optional cross-encoder reranking.
limitations: Examples must be adapted to each database, index schema, and embedding model.
The skill does not provide a hosted search service or benchmark runner.
Production systems still need access controls, monitoring, and latency testing.
The PostgreSQL filter example needs key validation before production use.

use_cases.title: Improve RAG Recall
use_cases.description: Combine semantic matches with exact term matches for more complete retrieval in document assistants.

use_cases.title: Add Database Search
use_cases.description: Plan a pgvector and full-text search design for application data stored in PostgreSQL.

use_cases.title: Compare Fusion Methods
use_cases.description: Evaluate RRF, weighted scoring, and reranking approaches before committing to a search architecture.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Hybrid Search Design
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for a new RAG feature.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a hybrid search approach for my RAG system. Explain when to use vector search, keyword search, fusion, and reranking.

prompt_templates.title: Implement RRF Fusion
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me implement reciprocal rank fusion for vector and keyword result lists. Include edge cases and tests I should run.

prompt_templates.title: Build PostgreSQL Retrieval
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a PostgreSQL hybrid search plan using pgvector and full-text search. Include schema, indexes, filtering, and validation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Tune and Evaluate Reranking
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my hybrid search pipeline and propose an evaluation plan for weights, candidate counts, reranking, latency, and recall.

output_examples.input: I need better recall for a RAG assistant that misses exact product names.
output: Recommended using vector retrieval for semantic matches and keyword retrieval for product names.
Suggested RRF to merge candidates before reranking the strongest matches.
Listed validation tests for exact terms, long questions, and empty result cases.

output_examples.input: I want PostgreSQL hybrid search for internal documents.
output: Outlined tables for content, embeddings, metadata, and full-text indexes.
Recommended pgvector indexing, GIN full-text indexing, and safe metadata filters.
Added checks for query latency, recall, and metadata access control.

output_examples.input: My Elasticsearch vector search ignores specific ticket IDs.
output: Suggested adding BM25 matching for exact ticket identifiers.
Recommended balancing vector and text scores before final reranking.
Included a measurement plan for exact-match recall and ranking quality.

best_practices: Tune vector and keyword weights with real queries and relevance labels.
Use RRF first when score scales differ across retrieval methods.
Log component scores so ranking changes can be debugged and evaluated.
anti_patterns: Do not replace keyword search when users rely on exact names, codes, or identifiers.
Do not copy template filters into production without validating user-controlled inputs.
Do not optimize only top results without checking recall across the candidate set.

faq.question: What does hybrid search mean here?
faq.answer: It means combining vector similarity with keyword search, then merging or reranking the results.

faq.question: Does this skill generate embeddings?
faq.answer: It explains where embeddings fit, but you must choose and run an embedding model separately.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill is written as implementation guidance for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: Which fusion method should I start with?
faq.answer: Start with reciprocal rank fusion when vector and keyword scores are hard to compare directly.

faq.question: Does it support Elasticsearch?
faq.answer: Yes. The playbook includes Elasticsearch patterns for dense vectors, BM25 matching, and RRF-style retrieval.

faq.question: Is the code production ready?
faq.answer: No. Treat the examples as templates and add validation, tests, access controls, and monitoring.
